abstractEnglish: We prove Uchida's conjecture on open homomorphisms of Galois groups. Every continuous open homomorphism between Galois groups of solvably closed Galois extensions of number fields is induced by a unique equivariant field embedding in the opposite direction. No restriction on the kernel or additional compatibility hypothesis is required.

details.overview: 稿件研究数域上可解闭伽罗瓦扩张的伽罗瓦群之间的开连续同态。作者声称证明了Uchida关于伽罗瓦群开同态的猜想：任意此类连续开同态都由唯一一个反方向的等变域嵌入诱导。摘要强调不需要对核施加限制，也不需要额外的相容性假设。该结果刻画了可解闭伽罗瓦群开同态的刚性，属于伽罗瓦群重建理论。
